methodology.timed: Only new TriangleBVH(vertices, indices, normals, ownsContact), including constructor validation, centroids, partitioning and all nodes.
methodology.fixture: One actual current-commit TrackContactMesh, including authored normals and ownership, supplies identical immutable arrays to both constructors. At 8192 rows the actual default constructor argument is exercised.
methodology.scheduling: One fresh bounded-heap Node child per case; children run sequentially. Pair 0 runs baseline/current, pair 1 current/baseline, repeating for warmup and measurement.
methodology.retention: A single untimed mesh tree remains resident because its actual ownership callback captures its mesh. Each measured tree is compared against compact binary reference snapshots, then released before the next explicit GC. No sequence of large trees is retained.
methodology.equivalence: Independent leaf reductions and parent unions validate exact signed-zero-sensitive bounds, balanced contiguous topology, leaf sizes and a complete triangle permutation. Binary snapshots compare every node field and ordered triangle against the actual baseline. Sampled ray, cached vertical and tire queries compare full hit outputs and candidate counts bit-for-bit.
limitations: Constructor microbenchmark with warmed code; not a whole-game, cold-start, browser, frame-time or FPS result.
Explicit GC is outside timing; naturally occurring collections during a constructor remain included.
Queries cover deterministic samples and edge/miss cases, not every possible ray.
One runtime, host and run; frequency scaling, scheduler noise and JIT variability remain possible.

verification.binaryLayout: Each node: float64LE min[3], max[3], then int32LE left/right/start/end (64 bytes). Order: uint32LE triangle IDs. Query: float64LE found/distance/triangle/point[3]/normal[3]/triangleTests/featureTests (11 numbers).

memory.note: Observed after builds; maxRSS is the OS process high-water mark and includes untimed setup and checks.
